<!-- pr-reviewer: 6262d164f981f54cf886cc8e20e18cb4b914b2b5 -->
Read-only review (no worktree, no build; the release gate tier ran green per the PR body). **Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

1. Files: OK. Only CHANGELOG.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, RECOMMENDED.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, the three snapshot PNGs, and 57 deletions under docs/decisions/ (README.md stays). No source, test, asset, script or workflow file.
2. Version: OK. Workspace version 0.18.0. Cargo.lock changes are exactly 10 version lines 0.17.0 -> 0.18.0 on the workspace crates (app, cl, geometry, kernel, motion, post, sim, tools, ui, xtask); no dependency or source/checksum line touched.
3. RELEASE_NOTES.md: OK. Starts `# CamCraft 0.18.0`, first `---` at line 214 with history after it, "Breaking: none", Known issues list #950, #980, #934, #946, #864, #906/#885, #938, Process changes cover PROCESS_VERSION 11-16, and the snapshot-goldens-accepted-without-look statement is present. I found nothing that contradicts the PR list.
4. CHANGELOG.md: OK. 50 new rows at the top, all 0.18.0, 4-column table intact, no stray markers, no duplicate PR numbers.
5. RECOMMENDED.md: OK. One `## v0.18.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` heading; spot-checked #27, #93, #220, #614, #671, #980 and #905 (the gather keeps its title as `# #905: ...`), all present under it.
6. Closing keywords: OK. closingIssuesReferences is empty; no fix/close/resolve + #N in the body or commit messages.
7. Commits: OK. Eight commits: docs, test(ui) snapshots, chore(release), and the merge of main; all conventional.

Notes (non-blocking): the PR body says "57 files" while the commit message says "56 per-PR decision files"; the 57th is the later #980 decision, so only the commit text is stale.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
